en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a brick corner building with shops at street level and apartments above. A tree frames the left side of the image; an old car is partly visible on the right. A lamppost stands at the corner, and several storefront awnings extend over the sidewalk. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Trollhättan, Folkets Hus, and a small imprint mark in the lower right credits a Stockholm-based publisher.
